summary.text: Lisa Hernandez has represented the 2nd District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2007.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature biography, Hernandez was previously a senior policy advisor to Lieutenant Governor Patrick Quinn and worked in Cicero Public Schools for 17 years.
Hernandez holds an associate degree in liberal arts from Morton College (2001) and a bachelor's degree in public administration from Northeastern University.
